meaning:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.26;
son of: Azzan (H5821)
§ Paltiel or Phaltiel = "God delivers"
1) son of Azzan and prince of the tribe of Issachar appointed as one of the 12 to apportion the land of Canaan
2) son of Laish of Gallim to whom Saul gave Michal in marriage after his mad jealousy had driven David forth as an outlaw

elsewhere.note: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.
